summary: Complete extraction vision and architecture plan for Kallaway's Power of Suggestion methodology. Defines a new third skill domain (Audience Obsession Engineering) with 12 practitioner-grade workflows organized in 3 tiers. Covers the Three Levels of Obsession (Signal → Belief → Action), the Five Universal Inputs checklist, and the Bankshot Suggestion framework. Includes uniqueness audit showing zero overlap with existing 20 Kallaway workflows, cross-expert stacking map across 8+ experts, and full deployment architecture for content writing, scripting, marketing copy, and asset creation.
